reviews.x: I don't usually wear makeup and I have never worn false lashes with the exception of the black magnetic set by a different seller I tried first. I'm fair skinned and fair haired. I usually go for a natural look if I do put on makeup. That being said I suffer from trichotillomania and rip out my natural lashes every so often. I did so again recently and was really upset with myself so thought to try a natural look false lash. Black was way too dark and brought more attention to not having my natu

This kit was an experiment. I look better in brown eyeliner and mascara, but only could get black magnetic lashes with black liner. (The double magnetic kind are also black). Thought this would be a good thing for me. Well . . . somewhat. The brown is exactly right for me for both the liner and the eyelashes. I used 2 coats (because umpteen places on youtube say to do that and making sure that it's a bit more dense on the inner and outer corners, too). I waited 15 minutes and then stuck the lash

reviews.t: I really like the lashes themselves
reviews.x: The lashes themselves are great as they come in a wide variety. However, the eyeliner is a dud and the lashes do not adhere. I've tried multiple coats of eyeliner, have tried letting the liner dry, have tried pressing tightly for a period of time in hopes that would help adhere the lashes, but nothing met expectations and resulted in the lashes falling off.

The band for the lashes is too stiff to stick. The magnets are very visible on the clear band. Plus, the brown of the lashes is too faint and light. I never thought I'd say that. However they look more false because the only part you see is the magnet. Plus the lashes don't match R to L and are not necessarily mirror images. In some cases, there appear to be two right lashes.  The brown liner is not adhesive. (Same brand grey liner is very adhesive, btw)

reviews.t: Color is cute, performance of the last isn’t
reviews.x: The color of the lashes is cute. However, my mom who I bought this for her birthday had to reapply the brown magnetic liner three times and it still wouldn’t adhere for her. Also another con is that the metal band is visible and it doesn’t look well made. We will not be returning them but we also won’t be repurchasing.

reviews.t: Eyeliner is clumpy, red brown, and does not hold
reviews.x: I like the lashes themselves: they look great. The color matches my dark blonde perfectly. My eyes are smaller, so I had to trim off a magnet, but I can tell that if I could get good eyeliner, they’d look awesome.  Unfortunately, when I put on the provided eyeliner, it clumps. Then it vaguely says “wait for eyeliner to dry” but I have no idea how long this would be and had to try several times. I got liner all over and it was miserable to try and get off the lashes. SO WORD TO THE WISE: definite

I should’ve taken a photo but I’m writing this as I’m two  hours late for a black tie event. I tried these brown lashes because I’m so blonde and fair skinned that black lashes don’t work. I tried all 5 pairs with both magnetic liner bottles after scrubbing off my makeup multiple times. Nothing worked. Then I tried the magnetic liner of a better pair I used to use which shows it’s the magnets in the liner. 5 pairs!! None of them stuck. I had nothing else on my lashes or eyelids, I’ve done this b

I liked the brown lashes, not so dramatic. I liked the assortment, fun to have different looks. Big problem, magnets stink. The magnetic liner stayed sticky even after 10 minutes of waiting.  After applying the lashes, the ends would pop up. They just would not stay. It's windy today, I'm afraid they'll blow off when I go out.  If you want good lashes, good magnets, go the extra money and buy Tori Bell.

reviews.t: Perfect for my fair skin and red hair.
reviews.x: I’ve been looking for magnetic eyelashes with a liner in brown. The color black is hard to wear with super fair skin without looking like a raccoon. These are perfect.
I use this product to enhance my eyes I am 78 years old and they make me look glamorous

These lashes are so pretty and how awesome they come in brown for a more subtle effect.  I wore these out to the store for a test run and they were great.  BE SURE TO USE 2 COATS OF LINER; one coat may hold, but 2 will for sure. It is very important to follow proper directions with these: 2 coats liner, let it dry completely, attach lash and you will have no problems. :) Liner comes off easily with eye-makeup remover and a cotton pad, ball, or swab.

I haven't been able to use the lashes as intended because the magnetic liner was dried out. I bought this brand because it was the only one that had brown lashes, which is why I'm giving it 3 stars. The lashes are natural looking and was able to wear one set using eyelash glue. I'll have to buy eyeliner separate in black because the brown liner that came with it was dried, and all the reviews for the brown liner say it doesn't work well.

Theyre lightweight, easy to remove, and the adhesion is okay. When the instructions say to let the liner dry completely before application, they mean COMPLETELY. I had to put a lot of liner on to make the lashes stay, which was annoying for me, I'm not used to wearing bold liner. The magnets looked kind of chunky against my lid, I felt like it would be obvious to anybody who looked that the lashes are super fake. It wasn't a great look.

Purchased there to try out for fun. I ordered a black kit and a brown kit. The black liner seemed to work better magnet wise. I loved the range in the style of lashes, you can go from natural looking lashes to full long glam lashes. The liner stays on very well and is comparable to waterproof liner. The ends still end up lifting some so I have to do a touchup in the middle of the day. Feel very light when I’m wearing them.

Fabulous product.  I LOVE that they come in brown which is perfect for my hair & skin tone.  The selection of varied lash density is great too.  It's best if you apply liner at the beginning of your makeup routine.  It needs time to fully dry.  By the time you're finished with your hair & other makeup, just pop them on.  AND, each set has 2 liners, 1 to leave home & the other two take with ..... 😃👍

[[VIDEOID:85e8d3caccd48bdfc6dbe6c9d054fd1]] I like that I finally have magnetic brown eyelashes but the brown eyeliner does not provide enough hold. There is some but not enough to wear these outside. The lashes themselves have quality magnets. It takes a bit to pull them off the strip on the tray, so it's definitely not the lashes. The brown eyeliner itself just does not have enough iron oxide.

I love the color of the lashes. My real eyelashes are light brown, and I have very fair skin. On me, the black lashes are too dramatic for an everyday look. This set of lashes goes great with my everyday makeup and liner is easy to apply. If you accidentally get liner on another part of your lid, use a Q-tip to remove it before it dries. I have also used the brown lashes with the black liner.

The magnets are huge and you can see the gap between your eyelid and the lashes.  The liner does not work as shown. Takes forever to dry and even then, it'll just come off your eyelid, so the lashes do not stay secure.  Don't bother. I may be returning these.

I was glad to find brown magnetic lashes! As I am new to false eyelashes, it does take some practice to apply the liquid eyeliner. But I kept practicing and they look great! I’m happy with the ease of application, the look and for the most part, the adhesion.

I liked the color of the lashes and the liner. It is hard to find them in brown. The lashes would not stick on the ends. I applied two coats and let dry. I tried  and tried to make them work. I worked on it all evening and they still would not stay in place.

I liked the color of the lashes and the liner. It is hard to find them in brown. The lashes would not stick on the ends. I applied two coats and let dry. I tried  and tried to make them work. I worked on it all evening and they still would not stay in place.

The eyeliner I received was unusable.  No amount of vigorous shaking would make it turn to liquid again.  I contacted through Amazon and asked for a solution and got no response.  Terrible service.  Useless product.  Very disappointed

reviews.t: Dried out clumpy  liner - does not work at all - do not purchase
reviews.x: The liner is dried out and clumpy - hard to get out of the tube.  So, these lashes do not work at all.  I returned one set and they sent a replacement - same thing - hard clumpy liner.  Save your time and do not purchase this product.

The lashes, themselves, are really pretty. My only complaint is, that no matter how many coats of the eyeliner I put on, they don’t stick. I’m pretty disappointed. Perhaps I should try a different brand of magnetic eyeliner.

reviews.t: The eyelashes are too light brown.
reviews.x: These eyelashes are too light brown for me. I thought the mascara was the only brown thing. All in all I really love this brand, but I can't use the light brown eyelashes. They are replacing them so I'm happy about that.

claims.text: Many reviewers love that the lashes come in brown, which suits fair skin and light hair better than black.
A common complaint is that the magnetic liner fails to hold the lashes, even with multiple coats or waiting for it to dry.
Reviewers frequently praise the variety of lash styles and the natural, lightweight look.
Several reviewers report the liner is clumpy, dries out, or stays sticky, and some find the magnet band visible.
Some reviewers note that applying two coats of liner and letting it dry completely is important for adhesion.
